name: Relocation Decision Analysis
prompt:
I am recently considering moving from Nanshan District, Shenzhen to Longgang District. Please help me analyze whether it is worthwhile based on my actual life data.
The data is in the relocation_data/ folder on the desktop: commute_records.csv (commute records for the past three months, including company and home coordinates), spending.csv (spending transactions for the past three months), preferences.md (the life preferences I wrote: values commute time, weekend hiking, and likes quiet).
Please analyze from three dimensions — changes in commute time (including the estimated commute from the new address to the company), changes in living costs (rent difference estimated at market price), and preference match — and give a recommendation on whether to move and what conditions must be met for the move to be worthwhile. The conclusions should be quantified (for example, X more hours of commuting per month, Y yuan saved on rent), and output to /root/Desktop/搬家决策分析.md.
